stations.title: Bryn
stations.say: Why does this parcel weigh nonsense?
stations.note: A code came out in halves.

stations.title: Picking desk
stations.text: Keeps every list as a plain array.

captions: Bryn packs parcels at Oakhollow, and one parcel's weight adds up to nonsense.
The desk keeps every list as a plain array, so a product code's halves get mixed up.
You give each list its type, and the product code a type for each place.
Now code HA-250 splits into a blend and a weight, and the parcel adds up.
Every list at the picking desk now says what it holds.
